en-US.description: Notes you can draw on, websites inside your notes, password-locked pages and a detailed calendar.
en-US.longDescription:
Tekinote is a free, ad-free notes app for Windows. Write pages and subpages with a slash command menu,
add photos and mark them up with a pen, arrows, shapes and text, or draw on a blank canvas.
Open any website inside a page, browse it without leaving the app, and draw on top of it.
Lock pages with a password: their text, photos and drawings are encrypted with PBKDF2 and AES-256-GCM.
The calendar has month, week, day, agenda and year views, recurring events, reminders and special days
with photos and a countdown. Everything is stored on your own computer; there is no account and nothing
is uploaded. Automatic backups go to any folder you choose, such as a USB drive or a cloud-synced folder.
The interface is available in English and Turkish.
en-US.name: Tekinote
en-US.releaseNotes:
Tekinote 1.8.2

🫥 Truly invisible hotspots — or visible ones, your choice
When you draw a link area on a picture, the dialog now has a switch: keep the box invisible. Leave it on (the default) and the spot shows nothing at all, not even when the mouse is over it — the picture stays exactly as it looks, and clicking still works. Turn it off and the area gets a soft highlight so people can see there is something to click.
You can change this later: in link mode, click an existing area and the same dialog opens.

🌐 Web links: inside Tekinote or in the browser
A link to a web address now asks where it should open:
- Open inside Tekinote — the site becomes a page inside the app, where you can browse it and even draw on it. The same address reuses the same page instead of piling up new ones.
- Open in the browser — your normal browser takes over.
Already using Tekinote? It updates itself — just press the green Update button at the top right.
